asks.label: Anchor event
asks.value: At least one consequential public-transport transfer whose PHYSICAL feasibility matters beyond timetable arithmetic; missing that connection/service must create a meaningful delay, last-return risk, or exertion consequence. No specific venue pre-selected — research must earn every choice.

asks.label: Binding mobility / dietary / sensory constraints
asks.value: BINDING mobility: 2 of the 8 travelers have low walking tolerance — repeated standing, stairs, long station walks, and rushed transfers are material costs, not footnotes. Luggage: the group carries luggage on the transfer from the Tottori side toward Kurayoshi / Misasa. Driving: assume no rental car unless research concludes a non-car plan becomes materially worse or unrealistic and says so explicitly.

asks.label: Additional comments
asks.value: Combined Research Run B — V02+V03+V05 validation trial per docs/pipeline v2/VALIDATION_TRIAL_PACKETS.md (frozen Tottori regional scenario). Operational validation data, not a live traveler request. Frozen intent: (1) local character matters more than checklist tourism; (2) thin English coverage must not be read as nothing useful exists; (3) Japanese-language research is valuable only when it strengthens or changes a decision — performative native searching does not count; (4) itinerary must include at least one consequential public-transport transfer whose physical feasibility matters beyond timetable arithmetic; (5) missing that connection must create meaningful delay, last-return risk, or exertion consequence; (6) group size and mobility must change recommendations, not appear only as generic allow-extra-time prose; (7) taxi/private transport may win when evidence supports it, but availability and cost must never be invented; (8) at least one meal/venue should require an actual party-size feasibility decision for eight adults.
